label: Resources
description: A gauge on the unit itself that shapes how it plays. A card has at most one. A price paid from the team's or player's shared stock (Company of Heroes munitions, money for an upgrade) is not a resource; say in the ability's summary, in words, that each use draws on that stock.

terms.label: Shared heat
terms.description: Weapons and abilities add heat to one gauge; overheating shuts the unit down briefly.

terms.label: Energy pool
terms.description: One pool feeds weapons, shields and abilities, so the player chooses what to spend it on.

terms.label: Fuel
terms.description: Flight or boost time drains a gauge that refills on the ground or at a pad. A boost's own tank, which only that one ability burns and which refills by itself anywhere, is not fuel: it is that ability's cooldown (see Cooldown bands).

terms.label: Limited ammo
terms.description: Total ammo is finite and does not come back on its own over time; only a supporter, a pickup or the base refills it, if anything does. Ammo that comes back on its own is the weapon's magazine trait, not this.

terms.label: Kill charge
terms.description: A meter filled by kills or damage dealt powers an upgrade or an ultimate.
